name: seo-audit
works_with: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Antigravity CLI, and other skills hosts
short: Audits a page or site for organic search in priority order and tells you which fixes to do first.
what: The skill works down five layers in order: can the page be indexed, is the foundation sound, is the page optimised, does it deserve to rank, and does it have credibility. It is strict about what a fetch can and can't show, so it won't claim speed scores, rankings or traffic it can't see, and it names the tool to check those instead. It also has checks from live audits, such as Next.js putting metadata in the body where AI crawlers miss it.
who: Site owners, marketers and developers who want a careful SEO review of a page that isn't ranking. It reads server HTML, so for rendered schema, speed and index data you still need Search Console, PageSpeed Insights or a crawler.
needs: Node.js, for the optional `check_head.mjs` and `check_llms_txt.mjs` scripts

steps.title: Add the marketplace in Claude Code
Install the SEO plugin

codex plugin marketplace add fcakyon/claude-codex-settings

steps.title: Optional: check what crawlers see
steps.text: From the skill's folder, this fetches a page as a browser, Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot and flags metadata a crawler finds only in the body.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: "Audit this page for SEO and tell me why it isn't ranking, with the fixes in order: <your URL>"

watch: It only reports what it can read from a fetch. It won't measure Core Web Vitals, index status, rankings or backlinks, and it tells you which tool does.
Pages that inject schema with JavaScript look schema-free to a fetch. The skill sends you to Google's Rich Results Test to check the rendered page.
The crawler check spoofs bot user agents, so a site that verifies crawler IPs may block those requests.
